name: add_component
description: Adds a component to the system zone. type: actor = person (stick figure); client = browser or phone; service = service box; database = cylinder; queue = queue or pipe; storage = bucket or folder; external = dotted cloud of a third party. 'parent' puts it inside a group.

service.description: AWS service (icon). Only if the speaker names it or there is no doubt.

parent.description: Id of the group it sits in (optional; without it, outside every group).

proposal.description: Id of the open proposal this belongs to (see propose); it is drawn in pencil. Leave it out for what the user asked for: that is drawn in ink.

name: connect
description: Draws an arrow between two components. Arrows join components only, never a group.

style.description: dashed = optional, asynchronous or weak relation.

both_ways.description: Arrow with a head at both ends.

proposal.description: Id of the open proposal this belongs to (see propose); it is drawn in pencil. Leave it out for what the user asked for: that is drawn in ink.

name: update_label
description: Changes the text of a component, group or connection, the name of an entity or the label of a relation.

name: delete
description: Deletes a component, group or connection, or an entity or relation of the data model. Never the system zone or the data zone: they stay for the whole session. Deleting a component removes its arrows; deleting a group keeps what was inside it, moved up to the group's own parent.

name: say
description: Speaks to the user in a speech bubble over the board. Exactly one per turn, even when nothing is drawn; if you send more than one, only the last is shown.

text.description: What you tell the user: about 25 words, concrete, at most one question.

target.description: Id of the element, group or proposal the bubble is about (optional; without it the bubble comes from a corner).

name: add_group
description: Draws an AWS group: a labelled box that holds components and other groups (AWS Cloud > Region > VPC > Availability Zone > subnet). The parent group must already exist. Put components in it with add_component's 'parent'. An empty group is drawn at a minimum size.

kind.description: aws_cloud = the AWS Cloud around everything on AWS; region = an AWS Region; vpc = a VPC; availability_zone = one Availability Zone; public_subnet = a subnet reachable from the internet; private_subnet = a subnet with no route from the internet; generic = any other boundary (an on-premises network, an account).

parent.description: Id of the group it sits in (optional; without it, at the top of the zone).

proposal.description: Id of the open proposal this belongs to (see propose); it is drawn in pencil. Leave it out for what the user asked for: that is drawn in ink.

name: set_parent
description: Moves a component or group into another group, or out of every group with parent null. A group cannot go inside itself or inside a group it contains.

id.description: Id of the component or group to move.

parent.description: Id of the group to move it into; null takes it out of every group.

name: propose
description: Opens a proposal: something you add on your own initiative, drawn in pencil until the user keeps it. Call it before the add_component, add_group and connect calls that carry its id in 'proposal'. 'alternative_to' makes it the other choice to an open proposal, drawn beside it; the user keeps one of the two.

id.description: Unique identifier of the proposal, e.g. 'P1'.

label.description: What it is, in 1 to 4 words, e.g. 'Static site'.

alternative_to.description: Id of an open proposal this one is the other choice to (optional; at most 2 side by side).

name: accept
description: Keeps an open proposal: everything drawn under it turns to ink. Accepting one of two alternatives erases the other.

proposal.description: Id of the open proposal the user keeps.

name: reject
description: Turns down an open proposal: everything drawn under it is erased, with the arrows that touch it.

proposal.description: Id of the open proposal the user turns down.

name: add_entity
description: Adds an entity (a table of the data model) to the data zone: a box with its name on top and one row per field. Mark the primary key with key 'pk' and each foreign key with key 'fk'. Always ink: an entity takes no proposal.

name.description: Name of the entity or table, e.g. 'orders'.

type.description: Short type, e.g. 'uuid', 'text', 'int' (optional; only if said).

key.description: pk = primary key; fk = foreign key to another entity.

fields.description: Its fields in order, primary key first. Only the ones said; may be empty.

name: set_fields
description: Replaces the field list of an entity already drawn: to add, rename, retype or remove a field, send the whole list as it should end up.

type.description: Short type, e.g. 'uuid', 'text', 'int' (optional; only if said).

key.description: pk = primary key; fk = foreign key to another entity.

fields.description: The whole new field list, in order: the fields kept, changed and added. A field left out is removed.

name: relate
description: Draws a relation between two entities of the data model, with crow's-foot ends for its cardinality. Entities only: components are joined with connect.

cardinality.description: Read from 'from' to 'to': one_to_many = one 'from' has many 'to' (a user has many orders: from user, to order); many_to_one the reverse; one_to_one; many_to_many.

label.description: Short verb over the line, e.g. 'places' (optional).

name: assess_pillar
description: Reports how the design stands on one Well-Architected pillar, for the review panel. One call per pillar in a pillar review; call it again when a pillar's status changes.

pillar.description: Well-Architected pillar: OPS = operational excellence; SEC = security; REL = reliability; PERF = performance efficiency; COST = cost optimization; SUS = sustainability.

status.description: covered = the design handles what matters for this pillar at this level of detail; partial = some of it; gap = it is missing.

note.description: Why, in one short plain sentence.

name: add_finding
description: Reports one risk of the design in the review panel, tied to the item on the board it is about. Only in a pillar review, or once one exists. It draws nothing.

id.description: Identifier of the finding, e.g. 'F1'. An id already listed replaces that finding.

pillar.description: Well-Architected pillar: OPS = operational excellence; SEC = security; REL = reliability; PERF = performance efficiency; COST = cost optimization; SUS = sustainability.

severity.description: high = data loss, a breach or an outage is likely; medium = it will hurt under load or when something fails; low = an improvement.

text.description: The risk in one plain sentence: what happens, and to what. Not a best-practice title.

target.description: Id of the component, group, connection or entity the finding is about (optional; leave it out only for a gap of the whole design).

best_practice.description: Id of the Well-Architected best practice it comes from, e.g. 'REL10-BP01'. Only real ids from the digest.

name: resolve_finding
description: Closes a finding once a change to the design settles it.

id.description: Id of the finding the design no longer has.

name: set_service
description: Puts on or changes the AWS service icon of an element already drawn (any type). An empty service removes it.

service.description: Service id; empty to remove it.

name: update_summary
description: Updates the one or two sentence summary of everything said so far.
